name: @suagr_xl/dsh-safety
author: 灏忓叞 (sugarxl)
description: A safety harness plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): protected-path enforcement, trash-based safe_delete with undo, last-known-good composition snapshots, pre-restart composition checks, and an audit journal.

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/safety.test.mjs test/state.test.mjs test/audit.test.mjs test/policy.test.mjs test/snapshot-store.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/safety-core.mjs && node --check lib/state.mjs && node --check lib/audit.mjs && node --check lib/policy.mjs && node --check lib/snapshot-store.mjs && node --check bin/dsh-safety.mjs
